home.title: Wholesale buying opportunities
home.description: Browse the opportunities on offer and see the product, the fulfilment city and the closing date. Commercial terms appear once you sign in with a trader account.
home.policiesDescription: Read the published policies before creating an account.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Use your commercial registration number and password.
login.noAccount: Do not have an account? Register

forgotPassword.title: Recover access
forgotPassword.description: Enter your email address and we will send recovery instructions.
forgotPassword.sent: If that address belongs to an account, recovery instructions are on their way.
forgotPassword.sentDetail: Check your inbox, and your spam folder if it does not arrive.

resetPassword.title: Set a new password
resetPassword.description: Choose a new password for your account.
resetPassword.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
resetPassword.missingToken: This page needs a recovery link. Request a new one to continue.
resetPassword.linkUnusable: This recovery link is no longer usable. Request a new one to continue.

verifyEmail.title: Verify your email address
verifyEmail.verifiedDetail: You can now sign in with your commercial registration number.
verifyEmail.missingToken: This page needs a verification link.
verifyEmail.linkUnusable: This verification link is no longer usable.
verifyEmail.resendHint: Once signed in you can request a new verification email.

register.description: Create your company account. You will sign in afterwards with your commercial registration number.
register.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in

policies.unavailable: Policies could not be loaded. Registration cannot be completed right now.

location.description: We need your company's coordinates to plan fulfilment.
location.requiredNotice: A location is required before you can create the account.

errors.unsupported: This browser cannot provide your location. Enter the coordinates manually below.
errors.insecureContext: Location is only available over a secure connection. Enter the coordinates manually below.
errors.permissionDenied: Location access was blocked. You can allow it in your browser settings, or enter the coordinates manually below.
errors.positionUnavailable: Your location could not be determined. Try again, or enter the coordinates manually below.
errors.timeout: Finding your location took too long. Try again, or enter the coordinates manually below.
errors.unknown: Your location could not be retrieved. Enter the coordinates manually below.

manual.description: Enter the latitude and longitude of your company's location.
manual.invalid: Enter a latitude between -90 and 90 and a longitude between -180 and 180.

marketplace.title: Opportunities
marketplace.description: Every opportunity on offer right now. Filters and sorting apply to the whole list, not only to the page you are looking at.
marketplace.resultCount: {count, plural, =0 {No matching opportunities} one {# opportunity} other {# opportunities}}

filters.categoryExactMatchHint: The category is matched exactly: choosing a parent category does not include its subcategories.

card.closesInDays: {days, plural, one {Closes in # day} other {Closes in # days}}

empty.title: No opportunities are on offer
empty.description: Nothing has been published yet. Check back later.

emptyFiltered.title: No matching opportunities
emptyFiltered.description: Nothing matches the selected filters. Try widening or clearing them.

detail.noDescription: No description was provided for this product.

traderTerms.title: Commercial terms
traderTerms.description: Price, quantities and share size are available to trader accounts after signing in. They are not shown to visitors.

policies.title: Policies and terms
policies.description: The versions currently published. Unpublished text never appears here.

empty.title: No policy has been published yet
empty.description: No text has been published so far.

unauthorized.title: Access not available
unauthorized.description: Your account cannot open this page.

states.errorDescription: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.

errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

codes.VALIDATION_FAILED: The submitted data is not valid.
codes.NOT_FOUND: The requested item was not found.
codes.FORBIDDEN: You do not have access to this item.
codes.CONFLICT: This conflicts with the item's current state.
codes.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait and try again.
codes.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The commercial registration number or password is incorrect.
codes.EMAIL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED: Please verify your email address first.
codes.REGISTRATION_CONFLICT: Registration could not be completed with these details. If you already have an account, try signing in or recovering access.
codes.SUPPLIER_NOT_VERIFIED: The supplier account is not verified yet.
codes.TAXONOMY_CYCLE_DETECTED: A circular taxonomy cannot be created.
